_schema_guide.description: Master Common Identifier (CID) Dictionary Schema Guide & Example Value Options (ISO 14230-3)

keys.memory_size: Length in bytes in ECU RAM: 1 (uint8/int8), 2 (uint16/int16), 4 (uint32/int32).
keys.position: 1-indexed byte offset inside raw ECU parameter payload (typically 1).
keys.signed: Boolean indicating signed integer representation (true for int8/int16/int32, default: false).
keys.mul: Formula multiplier (floating-point or integer, default: 1.0). Formula: ((raw * mul) / div) + add.
keys.div: Formula divisor (floating-point or integer, default: 1.0). Formula: ((raw * mul) / div) + add.
keys.add: Formula offset addition (floating-point or integer, default: 0.0).
keys.description: Human-readable description and explanation of the ECU parameter.

throttlePressure.description: Pre-Throttle Charge Pressure (Actual Boost) (Druck vor Drosselklappe Rohwert)

engineTemp.description: Engine Coolant Temperature 1 (Motortemperatur, linearisiert und umgerechnet)

hpfpPressure.description: High Pressure Fuel Rail Pressure (Actual) (ungefilterter Raildruck Istwert (abs.))
